question: In the morning, a parking garage has 238 empty spaces, in a building that has operated for half a century, unrelated to today's count. By midmorning, 33 spaces fill up. By midday, 40 more spaces open up as early commuters leave. In the afternoon, 171 spaces fill up during a downtown event. By evening, 32 spaces open up. Finally, 41 more spaces open up as the event ends. How many empty spaces does the garage have now?

Tom had 164 stickers. He multiplied his collection by buying 4 packs. Each pack had more than he expected, so he added 26 stickers. He then created 8 sets with these stickers. Each set was duplicated 7 times through copying. He added 29 more stickers at the end. His friend's collection was separate from his totals. How many stickers does Tom have?

A library started with 213 books. They tripled the collection (multiplied by 3). They subtracted 549 for archiving. They multiplied by 7 for facility projections. They added 12 newly catalogued books. A donation of 100 books came later separately. Using a word quantity—triple the original amount—how many books after multiplying but before archiving?

A warehouse started with 71 boxes. They multiplied by 8 when loading shipments. Then by 6 again for a larger truck route. Then by 9 for a full regional distribution center count. After assembly, 8 boxes were damaged and removed. A major loss of 16132 boxes occurred due to a delivery error. Finally, they multiplied the remaining inventory by 9. How many boxes remained in their system for tracking purposes?

On Friday morning Lucia counted 214 boxes of tiles at the depot. Before lunch a delivery added 19 boxes. In the afternoon her colleague Marek, who had ordered fewer boxes than Lucia, brought 32 over from his own store. That evening a returned pallet added 79 more. Every box in the depot holds 3 tiles. The depot's roller door is 5 metres high. How many tiles are in the depot?

A factory had 75 items (morning production). They multiplied by 7 for batch multiplication. They subtracted 211 defects (mid-morning). They multiplied by 7 for shipment calculation. They multiplied by 7 again for annual projection. They multiplied by 6 for final scaling (evening, using 'double' as word quantity and 'one distractor': competitor made 50000 items). After multiplication but before defect subtraction, how many items in the late morning?

A contractor started with 24 tools Monday. He multiplied by 7 for job expansion. He added 73 more from supplies. He multiplied by 2 for both teams. He removed 22 tools to another site. His crew had 8 members. How many tools for the team?

A ferry company had 145 lifejacket lockers on its quay, and 85 lockers were moved to a new pier. Each locker still on the quay holds 8 boxes, and every box holds 9 lifejackets. A safety audit then added 64 lifejackets to the quay. The company shipped 3173 lifejackets out to its island route. The ferry crossing takes 40 minutes. How many lifejackets are on the quay?
A task had 178 hours. Multiplied by 7 crew. Added 62. Multiplied by 4. Added 53 contingency. How many hours total?

A community garden starts spring with 109 pounds of compost in its bin, or about 1744 ounces. A neighbor drops off 48 more pounds of kitchen scraps to compost. A warm, rainy stretch of weather brings the compost's total weight to 2 times what it was. A local school then contributes another 70 pounds of leaves and clippings. The garden also hosted 25 volunteer sign-ups that spring, a number unrelated to the compost weight. A big giveaway to garden plot holders then takes 307 pounds from the bin. A final rich batch from the compost tumbler brings the remaining compost to 2 times what it was. How many pounds of compost are in the bin now?

On Sunday morning a cafe cooked 72 pancakes and shared them equally between the 6 tables that were waiting, and Alma's table always eats more than Boris's table does. Before lunch Alma's table ate 4 of its pancakes. The cafe has 20 chairs. In the afternoon the cook made 4 times as many pancakes as were still on Alma's table and brought them over. That evening a neighbour dropped off 5 more pancakes for the same table. How many pancakes does Alma's table have now?

In the morning, a birdwatcher counted 37 eggs across the birdhouses in the sanctuary. By midday, 7 more eggs had been laid. In the afternoon, 33 eggs hatched and the chicks left the count. Later, 9 more eggs were laid in a new nest. By evening, 12 eggs were found broken after a storm. How many eggs remained in the birdhouses by evening?

In the morning, a factory had 105 units. They multiplied production 8 times. The output was then divided by 5. They removed 166 units for quality control. Finally, 1 more unit was removed. How many units remain?
A candy maker has 25 pounds of candy. She multiplies by 7 (175), then by 2 (350), then by 9 (3150), then by 2 again (6300). A rival shop has 1000 pounds. How much candy does she have?

A warehouse starts with 214 units. They add 8 units from a late delivery. They lose 22 units to damage. They add 20 units from returns. They multiply by 9 to account for 9 distribution centers. They multiply by 4 for quadruple scaling. They multiply by 8 to project across 8 months. Converting to thousands, what is the total?

On Wednesday morning a phone shop had 157 handsets in the back room and 6 more arrived at lunchtime. During the afternoon the staff put every handset on charge for 9 minutes to test it. The supplier agreed to pay for 830 of those charging minutes. In the evening the shop was billed 6 cents for each of the minutes the supplier had not covered. The bill is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents was the shop billed?

On Saturday morning the corner shop had 60 jars of marbles on its shelf. A delivery van dropped off 45 more jars before lunch, and during the lunch rush 102 jars were sold. In the afternoon a second delivery added 72 jars to the shelf. Every jar still on the shelf that evening contained exactly 8 marbles. Each of those marbles was worth 6 points in the shop's Saturday game. How many points were sitting on the shelf that evening?

A restaurant kitchen had 50 dinner plates. 44 plates were broken during cleaning. 26 new plates were purchased. 62 plates were delivered from a wholesaler. 73 additional plates came as a promotion gift. All plates were then stacked triple-high for storage. His friend Henry had helped with the inventory. How many plates are stacked in total?

A farmer planted 121 seeds initially. He added 20 more seeds in the morning and 54 in the afternoon. He multiplied the total plantings 9 times by planting in rows. He then removed 663 diseased plants. Finally, he added back 64 healthy seeds and 68 more for backup. The field irrigation system cost $500. How many plants were there after multiplication but before removing the diseased ones?

A factory had 104 items. They divided by 4 for quality control. They multiplied by 6 through production scaling. They subtracted 36 damaged items. They added 6 more. They doubled (multiplied by 2) for shipping (and using 'minutes to hours' as a unit change and asking for intermediate state). After division but before multiplication, how many items?

A café starts the morning with 47 pastries baked. By mid-morning, 25 more pastries come out of the oven. Then 32 pastries are sold to the first wave of customers. By afternoon, 73 more pastries are baked for a catering order. By evening, 106 pastries are delivered to that catering event, a delivery that takes 40 minutes, well under an hour. How many pastries does the café have left?

A single library book cart started the morning with 219 books. In the morning, 6 more books were added from returns. A matching donation then left the cart with 9 times as many books. The books were then split evenly among 3 branch libraries, and this story follows just one branch. Finally, 163 books were checked out to students, around the time a librarian mentioned shelving a dozen new magazines, unrelated to this count. How many books were at that one branch in the end?

A shop had 214 products. They removed 213 products. They multiplied by 5 times. They removed 4 products. They multiplied by 6 times. They multiplied by 8 times. Morning inventory, afternoon sales, evening recount with a dozen items mentioned. How many products?

A store had 117 items in inventory. They removed 109 items for a sale, leaving 8. They removed 2 more for customer requests, leaving 6. They multiplied by 6 to order replacement stock to 36 items. They added 25 items from a shipment, reaching 61. Her manager handles 50 items (separate inventory). How many items total does the store have now?

A gardener had 139 flower seeds. She multiplied by 5 for spring planting. She added 79 more from a new package. She added 52 seeds from a gift. She multiplied by 9 for propagation planning. She added 5 rare seeds. Nearby, a neighbor also plants 30 seeds annually, which is separate. How many seeds does the gardener have?
